title: PartnerDatasetDownloadJobDto
description: DTO for an asynchronous dataset download job. The formatted report itself can be downloaded by the client using the provided signed bucket URL. A formatted report is considered transient, and is identified by the download job that formats it. Note that a signed bucket URL will expire after a fixed period of time, typically 24 hours.

id.description: UUID of this download job. The job will automatically expire after a fixed period of time after completion.

description.description: Best effort explanation for the status.

reportName.description: Suggested report filename for the formatted dataset.

contentType.description: MIME Type of the formatted dataset.

datasetIDs.description: List of Dataset IDs that will be included in the download job. The API will always return a single ID since it does not support merging datasets.

jobCreatedAt.description: Timestamp when the download job was created.

rows.description: The number of rows in the formatted dataset when COMPLETED.

signedBucketUrl.description: The signed URL to download the formatted dataset when COMPLETED.

crc32c.description: Checksum of a formatted dataset when COMPLETED, this can be used by the client to verify the download. Not available for legacy reports.
